name: Lustbringer - Mentorship
source:
In a society where the economy and the energy is sustained with the power of love and lust, the lustbringers, at the same time priests and public servants of love, are one of the most prestigious citizens. Sal and Astan are a married couple who once where one of the most reputed among them but now are retired and enjoying a new stage of their life.  One day, their old boss, Lara Roh, shows at their door and she is not alone. The lustbringers organization has found a promising aspiring girl, Nere, but she seems to not be very fit for the regular training, or to follow any rule. Because of this, Lara Roh, will ask Sal and Astan to allow the girl to live with them and mentor her so she is able to achieve her full potential.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/elanachampionoflust/about]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
在這個社會裡，經濟和能源都靠愛與情慾的力量維繫。欲使既是祭司，也是為愛服務的公職人員，是最受尊敬的一群公民。薩爾與阿斯坦是一對夫妻，曾是其中最負盛名的一對，如今已退下來，享受人生的新階段。有一天，舊上司拉拉．羅登門拜訪，還帶了個人來。欲使組織發現一個很有潛力、立志成為欲使的女孩內蕾，可她似乎既不適合常規訓練，也不適合遵守任何規矩。於是拉拉．羅想請薩爾和阿斯坦收留這個女孩，親自指導她，幫助她充分發揮潛能。
